name: query-loop-list
title: Post Grid (Query Loop)

layoutKnobs: which post fields appear + their order

locked: query > post-template > [post-* fields] nesting — post-* blocks are ONLY valid inside post-template
query-pagination is a direct child of query, sibling to post-template
headings here are h2/h3 — never h1 (hero owns the single h1)

compositionRules.requiresDynamicContext: post-* blocks resolve against the loop's current post; meaningless outside a query/template context

notes: This is the IR's hardest case: a DYNAMIC block (query) whose inner post-template is a TEMPLATE applied per-post, not static content. The IR must distinguish 'static subtree' (hero) from 'template subtree applied N times' (post-template). post-* blocks are context-bound — the validator must reject them outside a query/post-template ancestor. inherit:false means this query defines its own params (vs inheriting the template's main query).
